notes.text: No original Top 8 lists survive: the StarCityGames Top 8 coverage text has no lists, Wizards published none, and no Morphling.de or mtgtop8 page was found. All eight lists are copied from the lhc Deckbox sets, as printed, without corrections.

Finishes from the StarCityGames Top 8 coverage: quarterfinals Biller def. Cron, Simister def. Trudeau, Conedera def. Rotchadl, Allen def. Menendian; semifinals Allen def. Simister, Biller def. Conedera; final Biller def. Allen. Seeds are not known.
About 151 players according to a later StarCityGames article ("Another Look at the Vintage Restricted List"); not confirmed elsewhere.
Date from the Wizards "2004 Type 1 Championship" page (Saturday, August 21, 2004, Gen Con Indy).
Archetypes are the names on the Deckbox sets.
